chunks: When you enter the mosque, look toward the Kaaba and say: “All praise is due to Allah, who magnified you, honored you, ennobled you, and made you a place of return for the people, a sanctuary, blessed, and a guidance for the worlds.”

key_terms.أَمْنًا: a place of safety and security
key_terms.عَظَّمَكَ: He magnified you, granting greatness and sanctity
key_terms.مَثَابَةً: a place of return, where people repeatedly come back
key_terms.هُدًى: guidance, a means of direction for people
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْدُ: all praise and gratitude belong to Allah
key_terms.ٱلْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaaba, the sacred House toward which believers turn
key_terms.ٱلْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, here referring to the Sacred Mosque

ai.seo_question: What should be said when looking at the Kaaba upon entering the mosque?
ai.summary: This text teaches a du'a to be recited upon entering the mosque and looking at the Kaaba during hajj. It expresses praise to Allah for the sanctity, honor, and blessed status He granted to the Kaaba as a place of return, safety, and guidance for humanity.
